title: Account list research & ICP scoring
summary: Paste up to 10 company websites and get each one researched, scored against your ICP and ranked with an opening line.
setup: Import the template. No apps or secrets are required.
Run it with up to 10 company websites, and optionally a description of your ideal customer.
Edit the `icp-scorer` agent to bake in your own ICP and scoring rules.
